name: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
label: Quest
description: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You question why you are still alive. After all, you have in your possession an item of great evil. The answer is not clear, friend. I only do as I must.
Kel'Thuzad sits atop his throne in Naxxramas, plotting... He seeks that which you hold and holds that which you seek.
As for the base of the staff; the dwarf, Brann Bronzebeard, held it when he entered Ahn'Qiraj. He has left Ahn'Qiraj but the base of Atiesh remains.
Should you succeed in recovering the pieces, return them to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: In its current form, the staff is far too dangerous to be in the hands of a mortal.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There is a being within... A being not of this world.
